title: Character Art & Visual Quality Overhaul (All 9 Characters)
author: Antigravity Senior Technical Artist
objective: Upgrade all 9 playable characters in SkeletalRenderer from thin/flat stylized capsules into richly layered, volumetrically shaded 2D/2.5D stylized anime-realism game characters faithful to assets/images/characters/char_*.png while preserving 100% of combat, hitbox, timing, Vovinam skin switching, and secondary cloth motion.

Distinct volumetric body types per character with natural compact hand/fist proportions. 3. Layered 3D costume geometry (lapels, draped coats with open hanging sleeves, wide bell sleeves, sculpted chest crests, overlapping tasset scales, coiled multi-tail scarf, tailored high trench collars, baggy ankle-cuffed martial trousers, armored greaves & wraps). 4. Multi-cluster character-specific hairstyles & structured facial anatomy (brows, irises, cheekbones, age lines, scars, goatees). 5. Fix stale 'Trần Bích Lâm' preview/comment typos to 'Đình Bích Lâm'.
acceptanceCriteria: All 9 characters exhibit distinct volumetric body builds and compact anatomical hands
Costumes, armor plates, fabrics, coats, robes, scarves, and weapons render with multi-layered 2.5D structure and material-specific shading
All 9 characters feature distinct multi-cluster hair and structured anime-realism faces matching char_*.png
Pure black Silhouette (#000000) renders 100% solid with zero color leakage across all 9 heroes and poses
Zero combat, hitbox, damage, cooldown, or Vovinam skin switching regressions; 23/23 suites & browser smoke pass with 0 console errors
